authority.purpose: Versioned catalogue of launch evidence requirements only

controlledPilot.authority: Secured manual bank transfer, cheque or cash evidence followed by explicit Admin approval and exactly-once activation

unrestrictedPublicLaunch.policyChangeRule: Removing Stripe from unrestricted public launch requires a separate reviewed governance change to the runtime hard-launch gate; this static file cannot waive it.

hardLaunchGates.evidence: Canonical Founder/Admin authentication with verified Firebase MFA
Owner, Tenant, Technician, Broker, Admin and global mechanics on one deployed exact SHA
Owner acquisition, quote, OTP signature, payment review and exactly-once activation
Tenant request, Storage proof, dispatch, completion, approval/dispute and physical delivery evidence
Physical-device GPS plus before/after evidence with canonical server location records
Lead conversion, active contract, deterministic commission, OTP payout and Admin settlement
Valid production clients accepted and invalid or missing tokens rejected for intended Firebase services
Provider delivery receipt and recipient mailbox evidence with SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment
Gemini, OpenAI fallback, App Check rejection, redaction, quota, token, cost and latency evidence
Production scheduler execution and resulting renewal records and delivery evidence
Current secret versions, revoked prior credentials and canonical Founder access
Required only by the current unrestricted public-launch policy
Frozen SHA, monitoring, rollback and at least 24 real hours with zero open P0/P1
Final protected HMAC-signed decision bound to evidence hashes and exact deployed SHA

interpretation.controlledPilot: May start only after every pilot-required runtime gate is green for the same frozen deployed SHA.
interpretation.publicLaunch: Remains NO-GO unless the protected signed decision explicitly returns hardLaunchClaim=true.
interpretation.scores: Removed. Numeric static readiness scores are not operational evidence and must not be displayed as current launch status.
